info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Parking Reservations Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Status API provides users with real-time access to the current status of parking reservations. By calling this endpoint, developers can retrieve detailed information regarding various reservation statuses, aiding in efficient parking management. This API is ideal for applications in the parking industry, such as mobile apps that help users check reservation availability and status updates. Typical consumers include parking lot operators, app developers, and businesses focused on enhancing user experience in vehicle management.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of reservations.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the status of their reservations, providing insights into whether they are confirmed, pending, or canceled. It serves as a useful tool for managing customer expectations and ensuring timely communication.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to indicate the status of reservations. It should include the necessary parameters required to fetch the current status of specific reservations as per the provided schema.

200.description: The request was successful and the reservation status is returned.
